title: Radio presets and station controls
summary: Feedback on radio features centers on convenience of station controls and preset behavior, while many excerpts are requests or observations about missing AM radio, SiriusXM display details, and voice or preset interactions without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention convenient steering-wheel radio controls, reliable return to the same station and volume, and straightforward radio interaction in some contexts.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly describe feature requests or unclear observations, including desire for AM radio, SiriusXM preset information, voice tuning behavior, and preset screen interactions.

limitations: Most excerpts are classified as undetermined, so the topic signal is dominated by requests and observations rather than clearly evaluative feedback.
Some examples in this cluster are terse or ambiguous, and one positive-assigned fragment discusses radio presets within a broader key-setting issue rather than radio performance alone.
